text: The Claude adapter v0.101.0 forwards each SDK `rate_limit_event` as a `usage_update`, with the SDK's `rate_limit_info` unchanged in `_meta["_claude/rateLimit"]`. That object holds `status`, `rateLimitType` (`five_hour`, `seven_day` and others), `utilization` and `resetsAt`. It comes only when the info changes, and never on an API-key or cloud-provider session. ACP itself has no rate-limit field. Source: the `rate_limit_event` case in the adapter's `prompt`.
